name: Level Maker
hook: Build a level, share it, play your friends’ levels.
how: Paint blocks, spikes, coins, a start and a goal on the grid, together with everyone in the room. Press Play to run it against the bots, then share it so other players can play it and like it.
controls: Mouse or touch to build; arrow keys or A/D and Space, or on-screen buttons, to play
uses: Publish your level; others browse the top and newest, play, like and report them. A link opens one for friends.
Your unfinished levels are kept as drafts in your player save.
Everyone in the room builds the same level and sees each other play it.
Bots run the level when you press Play.
The fastest clear of each shared level.
Pick a name and password to publish levels and keep them yours.
